member.summary:
Computes the out-of-place tensor transposition of A into B.
A tensor transposition plan is a data structure that encodes the execution of the tensor transposition. HPTT supports tensor transpositions of the form: $B_{\pi(i_0, i_1,...)} = \alpha * A_{ i_0,i_1,...} + \beta * B_{\pi(i_0,i_1,...)}.$
member.param: permutation of size representing the permutation of the indices. For instance, perm[] = { 1, 0, 2 } denotes the following transposition: $B_{i1,i0,i2} := A_{ i0,i1,i2 }$.
sizes/extents of each dimension of A
The outer-sizes of each dimension of A. This parameter may be NULL, indicating that the outer-size is equal to sizeA. If This is not NULL, [i] ≥ [i], 0 ≤ i < must hold.
The outer-sizes of each dimension of B. This parameter may be NULL, indicating that the outer-size is equal to sizeA. If This is not NULL, [i] ≥ ()[i], 0 ≤ i < must hold.
number of threads that participate in this tensor transposition.
indicates whether a row-major memory layout should be used (0 = column-major)
